fields.summary: User can log in with email and password
fields.description:
As a registered user I want to log in using my email and password so that I can access my dashboard.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Valid credentials redirect to /dashboard.
- Invalid password shows an inline error and stays on /login.
- Empty email or password disables the Login button.
- After 5 failed attempts the account is locked for 15 minutes.
